photos.desc: Creeping Daisy, Singapore Daisy - Wedelia trilobata, Sphagneticola trilobata (ASTERACEAE)
It is a yellow flower with 8 petals.
Another lovely invasive "weed". This one is part of a community blooming in the parking lot at MacArthur Beach State Park, North Palm Beach, Florida.

Common name : Wedelia, Yellow dots, Creeping daisy, Bay Biscayne creeping-oxeye, Rabbit's Paw, Water Zinnia Botanical name : Sphagneticola trilobata (syn. Wedelia trilobata ) - [ (sfag-net-TEE-koh-luh
